code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find solid rectangular frames of one non-background color.
    frames = []
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v):
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
        if all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # The frame with a nonempty interior pattern is the template.
    patterned=[]
    for f in frames:
        color,r0,r1,c0,c1=f
        pat=[[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
        if any(any(row) for row in pat): patterned.append((f,pat))
    if not patterned: return out
    (src,pat)=patterned[0]
    sc,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=src
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1 in frames:
        if (color,r0,r1,c0,c1)==src: continue
        if r1-r0-1==ph and c1-c0-1==pw:
            for i in range(ph):
                for j in range(pw):
                    if pat[i][j]: out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j]=color
    return out
'''
